item.title: How minimum wage, 70,000 naira transport allowance and oda resolutions by govment go benefit Nigerians
item.description: Workers for Nigeria go benefit from one N70,000 transport intervention allowance di Nigeria govment approve.

item.title: Wetin to expect from Russia-Africa summit and how e go benefit African kontris
item.description: Di third edition of di Russia-Africa summit dey happun for Moscow. Forty-eight delegations including 22 heads of state dey expected to attend di summit wey go discuss trade, security, food and energy matas.
